decision: No landing zone shares a Log Analytics workspace with another.
why: A shared workspace merges ingestion costs across landing zones, which breaks the cost ownership model.

links.note: Cost ownership is what requires a workspace per landing zone — a shared one would merge team bills.
Without diagnostic settings, the platform provisions a workspace but has no telemetry pipeline to fill it.

violations: Centralized Log Analytics workspace for general purpose logs.
Workspace retention raised beyond the period included at no charge.
